SELECT a.COMPANY_ID, a.COMPANY_CODE, a.COMPANY_NAME, CASE WHEN c.STATUS = 1 THEN '（年限≤1年）' WHEN c.STATUS = 2 THEN '（1年＜年限≤3年）' ELSE '（3年＜年限）' END STATUS_TYPE, c.LAST_UPDATE_DATE yearMonth FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier.scc_sup_company_info a LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.VENDOR_ID,MAX(DATE_FORMAT(b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m')) LAST_UPDATE_DATE, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, MAX(b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE), NOW()) <= 1 THEN 1 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, MAX(b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE), NOW()) > 1 and TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, MAX(b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE), NOW()) <= 3 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS STATUS FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_invite_head b WHERE b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.VENDOR_ID) c ON a.COMPANY_ID = c.VENDOR_ID WHERE a.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND a.IS_BACKLIST = 'N'
AND c.STATUS=#{status}

SELECT c.* FROM (SELECT b.BU_NAME, b.ORG_OU_NAME, YEAR(b.APPLY_TIME) AS YEAR, count(1) QUANTITY FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_expert a inner join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_expert_apply b on a.EXPERT_APPLY_ID = b.EXPERT_APPLY_ID WHERE a.HAS_QUITE = 'N' AND a.HAS_FROZEN = 'N' AND b.BU_NAME!=''
AND b.BU_NAME LIKE '%${buName}%'
AND b.ORG_OU_NAME LIKE '%${orgOuName}%'
group by b.BU_NAME, b.ORG_OU_NAME,YEAR) c ORDER BY YEAR DESC

SELECT c.* FROM (SELECT a.EXPERT_USER_ID, a.EXPERT_FULL_NAME, b.BU_NAME, b.ORG_OU_NAME, count(1) quantity FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_expert a INNER JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_expert_apply b ON a.EXPERT_APPLY_ID = b.EXPERT_APPLY_ID INNER JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_group gro ON a.EXPERT_USER_ID = gro.USER_ID INNER JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_project project ON gro.PROJECT_ID = project.PROJECT_ID AND project.TECH_OPEN = 'Y' WHERE a.HAS_QUITE = 'N' AND a.HAS_FROZEN = 'N' AND b.BU_NAME IS NOT NULL
AND a.EXPERT_FULL_NAME LIKE '%${expertFullName}%'
AND b.BU_NAME LIKE '%${buName}%'
AND b.ORG_OU_NAME LIKE '%${orgOuName}%'
GROUP BY a.EXPERT_USER_ID, b.BU_NAME, b.ORG_OU_NAME) c ORDER BY quantity DESC, ORG_OU_NAME DESC

SELECT x.YEAR, x.ORG_BU_NAME, IF(x.COUNT IS NULL, 0, x.COUNT) TOTAL_COUNT, IF(y.COUNT IS NULL, 0, y.COUNT) IMP_COUNT, IF(x.COUNT IS NULL, 0, ROUND(100 * IF(y.COUNT IS NULL, 0, y.COUNT) / x.COUNT, 2)) PERCENT FROM (SELECT YEAR(a.APPLY_DATE) YEAR, b.ORG_BU_NAME, count(1) COUNT FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_pr_requirement_head a INNER JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_npm_pr_require_head b ON a.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID = b.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID WHERE a.AUDIT_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND b.REQUIRE_FROM = 'MONTH' AND b.ORG_BU_NAME != '' GROUP BY b.ORG_BU_NAME, YEAR) x LEFT JOIN (SELECT YEAR(a.APPLY_DATE) YEAR, b.ORG_BU_NAME, count(1) COUNT FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_pr_requirement_head a INNER JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_npm_pr_require_head b ON a.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID = b.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID AND b.HAS_SEND_SOU_PROFILE = 'Y' INNER JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_bid_data_submit submit ON a.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM = submit.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM WHERE a.AUDIT_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND b.REQUIRE_FROM = 'MONTH' AND b.ORG_BU_NAME != '' AND submit.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND DATE_FORMAT(a.APPLY_DATE, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(submit.APPROVE_PASS_TIME, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY b.ORG_BU_NAME, YEAR) y ON x.ORG_BU_NAME = y.ORG_BU_NAME AND x.YEAR = y.YEAR
AND x.ORG_BU_NAME LIKE '%${orgBuName}%'
ORDER BY x.YEAR DESC, x.COUNT DESC

SELECT p.EXT_ORG_BU_NAME ORG_BU_NAME, SUM(r.AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, r.DESCRIPTION, YEAR(r.CREATION_DATE) YEAR FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_margin_record r LEFT JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_project p ON r.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID
AND p.EXT_ORG_BU_NAME LIKE '%${orgBuName}%'
AND r.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%${description}%'
GROUP BY r.DESCRIPTION, YEAR(r.CREATION_DATE), p.EXT_ORG_BU_NAME ORDER BY YEAR(r.CREATION_DATE) DESC
